title: docs(skills): objectstack-i18n teaches the action cancelText key and the dialog-key host refusals
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xCXNv1rVfDFJtPyVKBuKXPw)_

Fixes #32229

## 维护者速读

改了什么:`objectstack-i18n` 技能 `_actions.{action_name}` 一行补上 `cancelText`(确认框或参数框的取消按钮,仅在动作声明了 `confirmText` 或非空 `params` 时成立);`translation-target-unknown` 段落补上两种宿主拒绝:无非空 `params` 的 `submitText`、既无 `confirmText` 也无非空 `params` 的 `cancelText`,计数词由 Three 改为 Five。
为什么改:AI 作者读此技能决定写哪些动作键;缺 `cancelText` 就不会翻译取消按钮,缺两种拒绝就会把键放到不弹框的动作下,`os validate` 报错失败。
风险与回滚:纯技能文字 + 一个 `'@objectstack/skills': patch` changeset,不改代码;回滚即 revert 本 PR。token 棘轮 5921/6333,天花板不动。
先看:下方「Changed lines」两段 diff,及「Taught claims」表里的 `main` 行号。
两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`;对照 `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts` L2632–L2633 宿主表。
需要你做的:**Tier H**(`skills/**`),当前 head 还欠契约审查(contract review),之后需一位授权审批人 Approve,再由 skills 席位落地。

## Taught claims and their source on `main` (`60b99f8fd`)

| Claim in the skill | Source |
|:--|:--|
| `cancelText` is a key under `_actions.{action_name}` (and `globalActions.{action_name}`) | `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` L378 (the action entry's `cancelText` leaf); `checkActionEntry` serves both branches, `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts` L2044 and L2075 |
| It is the dismiss button of the confirm or param dialog | `translation.zod.ts` L374–L378; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionConfirmDialog.tsx` L69 and `ActionParamDialog.tsx` L1254 draw it, default "Cancel" |
| It holds only under an action that declares `confirmText` or a non-empty `params`, and there it is shown whether or not the action authors a `cancelText` | `validate-translation-references.ts` L2633 (host table), L2698–L2714 (`checkActionCancelText`, early returns L2700–L2701); `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` L1847–L1850 (`translateAction`'s `opensDialog`), served on `/meta` through `translateMetadataDocument` (L1889, `action: translateAction`; L5113–L5118 for an object's actions) and `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`; `packages/spec/src/ui/action-cancel-text.test.ts` L213–L217 pins the unauthored case; the param dialog also reads the key directly, `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` L352 and `RecordDetailView.tsx` L1604 |
| `submitText` under an action with no non-empty `params` is `translation-target-unknown` | `validate-translation-references.ts` L2632 (host table), L2673–L2687 (`checkActionSubmitText`, early return L2675) |
| `cancelText` under an action that declares neither `confirmText` nor `params` is `translation-target-unknown` | same file L2698–L2714 |

Every card claim holds on `main`. The first push also taught that a confirm dialog shows the bundle's `cancelText` only when the action authors its own. That read `useActionTextLocalizer.ts` L210–L245 on an untranslated action and missed the served `/meta` overlay above, which puts the bundle's string on `cancelText` before the hook runs. The contract review refused it, and the second commit removes the clause from the row and the changeset.

## Changed lines

`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, the `_actions.{action_name}` row (L164); only the inserted `cancelText` entry differs:

```diff
-| `_actions.{action_name}` | `label`, `description`, `confirmText`, `submitText` (the param dialog's button verb — only under an action that declares `params`), `successMessage`, …
+| `_actions.{action_name}` | `label`, `description`, `confirmText`, `submitText` (the param dialog's button verb — only under an action that declares `params`), `cancelText` (the dismiss button of the confirm or param dialog — only under an action that declares `confirmText` or a non-empty `params`), `successMessage`, …
```

The `translation-target-unknown` paragraph (L225 onward):

```diff
-that do. Three more shapes under an action entry are the error: an outcome the action does
+that do. Five more shapes under an action entry are the error: an outcome the action does
 not declare in `outcomeMessages`; a `resultDialog.fields` or `preflight.fields` path it does
-not declare (an action with no `preflight` declares none); and
+not declare (an action with no `preflight` declares none);
 `resultDialog` `title` / `description` / `acknowledge` under an action that declares no
-`resultDialog` — a bundle translates a dialog the action declares and cannot add one. A
+`resultDialog`; `submitText` under an action with no non-empty `params`; and `cancelText`
+under an action that declares neither `confirmText` nor a non-empty `params` — a bundle
+translates a dialog the action declares and cannot add one. A
```

The row's closing "the same keys hold under `globalActions.{action_name}`" already covers the global branch, so nothing is restated for it.

## Sweep

- `grep -rn "submitText\|confirmText\|cancelText" skills/objectstack-i18n/`: besides the two edited sites, L94 (the `todo_complete` example's `confirmText`, a sample bundle, not a key list), L163 (`_views.{view}.bulkActions.{def}`: `label`, `confirmText`, `confirmLabel`, `params`, a different schema, not the action entry) and L494 (the `confirmMessage` → `confirmText` alias note). None is a list of action dialog keys that `cancelText` makes incomplete. No change.
- `references/_index.md` is generator-owned and lists no action keys.

**Eval:** `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json` has two cases on the action key row. Case 10 (`crm_renew`'s `preflight.fields` path keys) is about one rule, keying by a field's literal `path`; adding the param dialog's dismiss button would make it a two-rule case, which the seat's ruling excludes. Case 1 (`_actions.crm_close.label`) names no dialog, so carrying `cancelText` would change its prompt's shape. No case is extended and none is added.
